title: Bluwhale announces trading agents for tokenised stocks and real-world assets
summary: Bluwhale, the AI financial operating system connecting millions of users to traditional and blockchain financial services managed by AI, today announced trading agents for tokenized stocks and real-world assets, including gold, silver and oil.
